subject: Sample ballot request – [Election date] election
body:
Hello,

I run KnowUS, a free app that helps voters see what's on their ballot. Could you please send the sample ballots (or ballot styles by precinct) for the upcoming [date] election in [County]? PDFs are perfect.

Thank you so much,
Owner's Rep
Samantha
KnowUS
